name: Socata TB 9/10 Tampico / Tobago
variants: TB 9 Tampico / Tampico Club (160 hp, fixed pitch)
summary: French four-seat touring and training single with fixed gear, the fixed-gear cousin of the retractable TB 20. Known for its wide, airy cabin.

wings: Low cantilever wing with no struts
Wing sits below a fuselage that bulges above the wing line
engines: Single flat-four in a smooth cowl
Two-blade propeller (fixed pitch on TB 9, constant speed on TB 10 and up)
fuselage: Rounded cabin hump with side windows rising into the roof
Wide four-seat cabin with a large glass area
Fixed tricycle gear, usually with wheel fairings
tail: Conventional horizontal tail on the rear fuselage

tellTales: Rounded, bulging cabin above the wing with windows rising into the roof
Low wing with fixed, faired tricycle gear
Wide, deep cabin that looks fatter than other low-wing four-seaters

confusedWith.howToTell: The PA-28 has a plain slab-sided fuselage; this has a rounded, humped cabin with side windows curving into the roof.
The AA-5 has a sliding bubble canopy over a stubby cabin; this has a conventional wide windshield and a hump-backed cabin.
The TB 20 has retractable tricycle gear and a bigger engine; this one has fixed, faired gear.
The Rallye is a shorter, stubbier older design with a slatted wing; this is a rounder, more modern four-seater without slats.
